name: nus.dev
description: nus.dev — the site for nus (terminus), a terminal emulator that is also a browser.

scripts.wasm: cd wasm/vt-wasm && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir ../../.wasm-pkg --no-typescript && cd ../.. && cp .wasm-pkg/nus_vt_wasm_bg.wasm .wasm-pkg/nus_vt_wasm.js assets/wasm/ && rm -rf .wasm-pkg
